notes: calc_psi macro (PROC RANK GROUPS=10 + PROC SQL bin-percentage/PSI-component calc) copied unmodified. Caller builds two 300-row synthetic score cohorts (base/comparison) and calls calc_psi exactly as macros/02_pd_validation.sas's pd_stability does. Note: because PROC RANK bins each dataset into its own independent deciles, base_pct and comp_pct are ~10%/bin by construction and PSI comes out ~0 for equal-sized samples -- this is the macro's own documented behavior (same call pattern as pd_stability), not a Jenner artifact; the bundle demonstrates the PROC RANK/SQL mechanics running correctly against the toolkit's own logic.
